summary_1line: Vali tells Indra he feels no grief at his fall, arguing that time, fate, and the transient body govern all fortunes.

image_candidates.scene_text: The fallen king Vali in the form of a humble ass stands in a lonely field while Indra, radiant and armed with the thunderbolt, addresses him.
Vali calmly speaks to the shining god Indra, explaining that all beings are swept away by the vast ocean of Time.
